answer: Four Mariner launch blockers are currently OPEN: (1) certificate rotation, owner Leda Fox; (2) restore drill, owner Mika Sen; (3) access review, owner Dev Shah; (4) supplier contract, owner Oona Reed. Mariner-Legacy, Mariner-Sandbox and Mariner-Lab blockers were excluded as other projects.
